methodology.interpretation: Target phrases are semantic search-intent candidates inferred from official support topics and observed public search results. They are not verified Google keyword demand, keyword difficulty, CPC, monthly search volume, current rank or a traffic forecast.
methodology.prioritizationBasis: Editorial priority is based on the existing driver-focused product and the availability of distinctive official tax-document guidance, not measured audience size or competitor traffic.
methodology.sourcePolicy: Prefer the actual worker/driver/sitter/freelancer support source. Merchant, restaurant, customer and similarly named company pages are not interchangeable. Provider help may describe a past tax year; verify the relevant year before publishing thresholds or specific forms.
methodology.classificationCaveat: The worker's actual agreement and records control. Editorial worker categories are not individual legal classifications.
methodology.reviewType: Collaborating-agent source/content review, not independent-provider assurance or legal review.

googleGuidance.recommendation: Give each company page original practical value, clear sourcing and truthful authorship. Financial topics require particular attention to trust; do not invent preparer credentials or expert review.
Do not multiply near-identical company, city, deduction and 1099 pages simply to capture query variants. Each indexed page needs a useful distinct answer, rather than serving only as a funnel.
Use real descriptive HTML anchor links from the company hub and related recordkeeping guides. Link every important company page from at least one other discoverable page.
Publish one preferred clean company URL with a self-canonical. Keep canonical, internal links and sitemap consistent; avoid competing .html, slash and alternate-domain copies.
List preferred public canonical URLs that should be indexed. A sitemap helps discovery but does not establish crawling, indexing or ranking.

If authorized access becomes available, export historical keyword estimates with the date range, United States targeting, language and network recorded. Close variants and targeting affect averages; estimates are not promised traffic.
Use the verified site's actual queries, pages, impressions, clicks and CTR after launch to revise page priorities. These observations measure this site rather than the total keyword market.

Useful visible questions and answers remain appropriate. Google announced that FAQ rich results stopped appearing on May 7, 2026 and removed their documentation in June; do not promise FAQ rich-result eligibility.

taxSourceGuardrails.requirement: Do not imply that receiving no information form eliminates the need to report gig income. Organize income and expense records and distinguish employee from self-employed work.

Do not publish a numeric reporting threshold, mileage rate, filing deadline or deduction entitlement from an undated generic template. Verify the relevant tax year, jurisdiction and current primary IRS guidance first.

A platform may issue different forms for different payments or worker relationships. A 1099-K payment total, a 1099-NEC amount, an annual summary and a bank deposit are not automatically the same measure.

Do not add a platform's reported gross earnings to the corresponding bank deposits as separate income. Explain reconciliation and retain source records; give no unsupported guarantee about tax treatment.

An official source describing a tax-document workflow does not establish that Gig Tax Pros has a direct API connection, automatic import, e-file authorization, approved banking integration or live provider sync.
Do not ask public-site visitors to enter SSNs, platform passwords or tax documents into a keyword landing page or local owner-interest brief.

Use IRS guidance for year-specific tax mechanics, even when a provider's help page includes an illustrative figure. During this review the Uber source and IRS publication disagreed on the 2025 mileage figure; the new page plan deliberately omits numerical rates.

observedPublicQueries.query: Uber driver tax summary 1099 tax documents
observedPublicQueries.observation: Official Uber tax information surfaced annual summaries and tax forms; use these as separate records, not interchangeable totals.
Official Dasher guidance surfaced the native Dasher-app tax-document workflow. Avoid assuming every company still uses Stripe Express.
Official sitter Tax Hub distinguishes payment-processing gross amounts and supporting summaries; customer sales-tax pages are not substitutes for sitter income guidance.
Official worker guidance confirms both employee and contractor shift categories, including a worker receiving both kinds of forms.
The official Stripe guide expressly distinguishes Instacart 2023-and-later form access through the Shopper channel from 2021–2022 Stripe Express history.

observedQueryLimits: Queries above were submitted through the available public web-search tool. Search-engine identity, Google SERP position, query popularity and volume were not measured. Tracking parameters were removed from evidence links where the clean official URL was verified or provided by the platform module.

pagePlan.initialStrategy: One useful company guide per assigned company; answer taxes, forms, recordkeeping and preparation intent together where appropriate. Avoid creating five thin pages per company.
pageChecklist: Unique title, H1, introduction and practical company-specific guidance.
Verified official worker tax/help links, with date and year limitations identified.
Classification and payment-form differences explained before expense advice.
An original records checklist and a truthful next step.
A self-canonical URL, readable HTML, accessible source links and inclusion in the preferred-URL sitemap.
pagePlan.separatePageThreshold: Split a forms, deductions, mileage or preparation page only when there is a distinct substantial answer, enough unique primary evidence and observed demand or a clear user-navigation need. Link it intentionally and prevent overlapping pages competing for the same answer.
pagePlan.keywordUse: Use one clear primary topic naturally in the title, H1 and opening. Include appropriate related terms where they help the answer; do not repeat a company name, add hidden keyword blocks or prescribe a keyword-density target.
pagePlan.coverageGoal: National reach is a goal. Local office, state service and partner-coverage claims require actual confirmed operations; do not create city doorway pages or pretend that an empty office map is a nationwide office network.

clusterApplicability.vehicleBasedWork: Add mileage only where the actual work involves a vehicle; remote freelance and helper pages must not imply a vehicle business.
clusterApplicability.mixedRoles: Apply the mixed-w2-and-contractor cluster prominently to Instawork, Wonolo and Veryable; their current source guidance supports both categories.

actions: Check every preferred URL, canonical, title, description and source link.
Confirm that public robots/CSP and redirects do not block the intended static pages.
Verify no test claims, fake offices, stale provider-menu instructions or unsupported filing promises remain.
Confirm the actual live canonical domain and HTTPS response for hub and representative company pages.
If account access is provided, verify the correct Search Console property and submit the generated preferred-URL sitemap; record the actual submission outcome separately.
Use URL Inspection and Page Indexing observations to diagnose discovery/indexing. Do not report submitted, indexed or ranking merely because a sitemap exists.
Export page and query data by country, device and date range.
Group actual query/page pairs by the intent clusters in this artifact, then improve unclear titles or missing answers.
Check whether one page satisfies closely related intents before expanding the page inventory.

Recheck provider document-navigation instructions before tax-season updates.
Reverify current tax-year IRS facts and source changes.

publicationBoundary: No provider affiliation, endorsement, approved integration or API access is established by a company-named informational page. Use truthful independent service wording.

reviewNotes.reviewScope: Source and content review only. No screenshot-based visual acceptance, Google account metrics, live deployment, indexing proof or independent-provider security assurance.
reviewNotes.correctnessCorrection: Lyft's Annual Summary eligibility was corrected to drivers who had earnings during the year, rather than every registered driver.
sourceLimitations: Many provider help pages discuss the prior filing season. Access instructions and tax-year claims require later rechecking.
Generic official FAQs for Amazon Flex, Spark and Veho do not establish a publicly verified current tax-document download menu.
reviewNotes.companyPageReviewMeaning: Source files and major factual boundaries were reviewed. Linked sources were researched by the collaborating module authors; this reviewer additionally retrieved the primary pages listed in highImpactPagesChecked. This is not a separate independent-provider audit.

providerHelpYearLimits.spark: An additional observed official help article explicitly describes 2025 documents; the page itself uses generic current FAQs and does not promise a menu.
providerHelpYearLimits.amazon-flex: The Flex FAQ returned an access error to this research fetcher. An official Amazon tax-interview reference is linked; a current Flex tax-download menu was not verified.
providerHelpYearLimits.roadie: A linked California adjustment article must not be generalized to all states or treated as all earnings.
providerHelpYearLimits.veho: The linked current driver-partner page establishes route work, not a public tax-document download workflow.

providerHelpYearLimits.instacart: The official Stripe article distinguishes 2023-and-later Shopper access from earlier Stripe Express delivery.
